en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a large, historic European building with a classicist architectural style. The building features ornate detailing, arched windows, and statues on the roof. There are several people walking on the street in front. The name 'K.K. POST- und TELEGRAPHEN AMTSGEBÄUDE' is visible on the building, signifying its use as a post and telegraph office. The foreground includes handwritten text. The reverse side is not visible.
